# onnxruntime-web 1.31.1

The engine that runs the scoring model in the browser, by Microsoft (MIT license, in LICENSE).
Copied unchanged from the npm package by `npm run vendor` (tools/vendor.mjs): `ort.wasm.min.mjs`, `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs`, `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm`.
Don't edit these files. To update, change the version in package.json, run `npm install`, then `npm run vendor`.
